verdicts.reason: A keeps every element, but the quote has shrunk until the bold yellow attribution almost outweighs it. The can is centred while the text is left-aligned, and it floats apart from the background circle, so the original's layered composition is lost. B is unusable: the quote is tiny and smaller than its attribution, it leaves 'soon.' alone on the last line, the product can is shrunk to an orange speck at the bottom, and most of the canvas is dead space.
